title: Looking up APB fields by meaning
text: read_parsed_levels() reads Parquet result apb2 wrote, one anndataR AnnData per level. bundle carries synthetic results; one MaxQuant’s peptidoform-ion level. DataCatalog answers result hands back data: MaxQuant reports q-value level, lookup gives NULL: lookup several fields answer signals UnresolvedField rather choosing silently. DIA-NN 1.8 reports one unnormalized normalized intensity per precursor:
code: results <- tempfile() utils::untar(system.file("extdata", "bundle", "results.tar.gz", package = "apbCatalogR"), exdir = results) result <- read_parsed_levels(file.path(results, "maxquant_wide-peptidoform_ion.parquet")) result #> <ParsedLevels> #>   peptidoform_ion: 2 x 3, layers: Intensity, MS_MS_Count, Retention_Time, Retention_Length, Calibrated_Retention_Time, Calibrated_Retention_Time_Start, Calibrated_Retention_Time_Finish, Score, PEP confidence <- DataCatalog$new(result, "confidence") pep <- confidence$layer("peptidoform_ion", kind = "pep") dim(pep) #> [1] 2 3 confidence$layer("peptidoform_ion", kind = "q_value") #> NULL tryCatch(   Catalog$new("DIA-NN", "1.8.1", "abundance")$layer("peptidoform_ion", kind = "intensity"),   UnresolvedField = function(condition) conditionMessage(condition) ) #> [1] "kind=intensity on peptidoform_ion is ambiguous: 2 entries match: Precursor_Quantity, Precursor_Normalised; candidates: Precursor_Quantity, Precursor_Normalised"

code: coverage <- rule_coverage("abundance") unique(coverage[, c("software", "version", "level", "verdict")])[1:5, ] #>    software version           level verdict #> 1  AlphaDIA    1.10 peptidoform_ion    warn #> 3  AlphaDIA    1.12 peptidoform_ion    warn #> 5  AlphaDIA     2.x peptidoform_ion    warn #> 7  AlphaDIA     2.x         protein    <NA> #> 8 AlphaPept     0.5 peptidoform_ion    pass
